title: Future Ukraine: Research Grants for Ukrainian Master´s students and researchers
summary: Short research stays in Germany for highly qualified Ukrainian Master's students, doctoral students, and researchers to strengthen cooperation and support Ukraine's science landscape.

degree_levels.notes: Includes graduates (Master's students), doctoral candidates, postdoctoral researchers, university teachers, and professors.

subject_areas.notes: Project proposals from all academic disciplines are eligible for funding. Other regulations apply for human medicine, veterinary medicine and dentistry.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised institution of higher education or non-university research institute in Germany.

nationality.notes: Ukrainian citizens OR eligible third-country nationals who held permanent residence in Ukraine before or on 24 February 2022. The alternative residence-based route must not be excluded by a nationality-only filter.

residence.notes: Regardless of the country in which they currently reside, provided they work/are enrolled in higher education institutions in Ukraine (or third-country nationals with a permanent residence permit in Ukraine before or on Feb 24, 2022).

mandatory.text: Applicants must be enrolled in or work at a Ukrainian university or a state-recognized research institution
Have Ukrainian citizenship or be a third-country national who has resided in Ukraine with a permanent residence permit before or on February 24, 2022
Good knowledge of German and/or English
Research project agreed upon with a scientific host/supervisor in Germany

exceptions.text: A master's degree program or a doctoral program at a German university is not eligible for funding, not even partially.

funding.description: Monthly payments of €992 for graduates (Master's students), €1,400 for doctoral candidates, €2,000 for postdocs, €2,150 for experienced researchers with a doctorate and university teachers, and €2,300 for professors. Includes health, accident and personal liability insurance cover if applicable, travel allowance if applicable, and a subsidy for additional costs resulting from disability or chronic illness.
funding.duration: One month to a maximum of six months

application_rounds.notes: Applications for research stays in 2027 are possible until 10. December 2026.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
List of published publications (max. 10 pages), if available
Research proposal as well as presentation of previous research work (max. 5 pages in total)
Schedule of the planned research work (work plan)
Confirmation of supervision by the academic host in Germany
Last university degree certificate with indication of final grade(s) or doctoral degree certificate
Other documents that support your application (e.g. certificates of employment, proof of internships or voluntary work, etc.)
Proof of knowledge of the research language (German, English or other)
Current proof of affiliation with a Ukrainian higher education institution
Proof of Ukrainian citizenship (passport copy) or for third-country nationals: permanent residence permit in Ukraine
German or English translations of documents submitted in any other language

steps.text: Prepare application documents and save in PDF format
Fill out the application form and upload documents to the DAAD portal

sources.title: Future Ukraine: Research Grants for Ukrainian Master´s students and researchers - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
